# CW Authors

> > Professional English editing and publication support services for academic researchers across scientific, technical, and medical disciplines.

CW Authors provides comprehensive editing, translation, and publication support for researchers preparing manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals. The service specializes in working with academic authors from diverse fields including agriculture, engineering, mathematics, and chemistry.

## Key Topics

- Academic editing
- English language editing
- Manuscript editing
- Journal publication
- Publication support
- Scientific editing
- Peer-review preparation
- Grant proposal editing
- Translation services
- Research support
- Author services
- Journal submission
- Editing packages
- ASABE journals
- Academic authors

## Core Services

- [English Editing Services for Academic Research](http://cwauthors.com/): CW Authors homepage offering English editing and publication support for academic researchers
- [ASABE Journal Editing Services](https://www.cwauthors.com/ASABE): Specialized editing services for ASABE journal authors in agriculture and biological engineering

## Resources & Guides

- [Planning Your Literature Review](https://www.cwauthors.com/article/important-factors-to-consider-as-you-start-to-plan-your-literature-review): Guide explaining essential factors and best practices for planning academic literature reviews

## Support

- [Contact Us](https://www.cwauthors.com/contact-us): Contact page with office locations and customer support information for CW Authors
